Subject: Aligning exec windows across hemispheres — DST contingency and rolling demo plan

Hi Heidi + team,

Thanks again for the time last week — excited to get the exec walkthrough on the calendar. Given we need presence from your CTO (Gonzalez), COO (Marta), and our VP Eng, I wanted to surface a few concrete windows that try to balance US / EU / APAC constraints while also guarding for the late-Oct DST transition.

Attached: global-demo-calendar-matrix.xlsx (3 proposed windows + conversion table) and a short runbook.

Proposed windows (please indicate which is best and who must be present):
- Option 1 (exec-friendly morning US): Wed Oct 28, 09:00 PT / 17:00 CET / Thu 00:00 HKT — favors US morning / EU late afternoon (APAC late night)
- Option 2 (EU-first): Thu Oct 29, 15:00 CET / 06:00 PT / Fri 00:00 HKT — favors EU/EMEA-friendly time, early US participation
- Option 3 (APAC-shifted rolling): Fri Oct 30, 23:00 HKT / 07:00 CET / 22:00 PT (previous day) — favors APAC later hours with US late evening presence

Notes: 1) Week of Oct 25 is DST-sensitive in EU (clocks roll back on Sun Oct 25) while US switches Nov 1 — so offsets between CET/BST and PT will change depending on exact date. The attached matrix has both pre/post-DST conversions. 2) If we need to avoid any midnight windows for senior execs, Option 2 is the least disruptive.

Can you share preferred option + any hard constraints (e.g., Marta cannot attend after 18:30 CET; Gonzalez prefers before 10:30 PT)? If helpful I can circulate a rolling invite with A/B/C timeslots and a canary fallback policy.

Thanks,

--

- Presenters: Marcus -> serving/runtime walkthrough (30m), Rishi -> security & rollout plan (10m), Laura -> SLA/rollback & pricing sensitivity (5m). That makes a tight 45–50m agenda.
- DST note: If we land on Fri Oct 30 well need to be explicit about CET vs. CEST; I built the matrix with both. Suggest we list times in local TZs in the invite and add a short line: Times reflect EU DST change (Oct 25) — confirm your local offset before accepting.

Ill mark Natasha as security lead and will prepare the sandbox access doc before the meeting.

-rishi
